display.appliesTo: CS2 weapon and glove skins requiring evidence-backed finish, wear and identity detail. Selection requests the CS2 profile only; independent authoritative classification can veto it. The augmentation is consumed by a base child that produces a 3D object.
display.notFor: Look-alikes or items without authoritative CS2 classification. Routing probability, names and heuristic detection do not establish identity. No game assets are supplied; exact textures require separately acquired, legally usable evidence.
